tweets.text: Crazy to think that this was the first version of OpenRouter. https://t.co/9n84zDTkTZ

This was heavily inspired by https://t.co/j2AU3LVMH1. I thought, why stick to barbershops and why a static background? So I added dynamic video, made it go on forever, and take in any mood!

I sadly had to take down the website but you can easily make your own (I’ll post the GitHub) with yt-dlp doing the audio fetching

Made a lil website that takes a "mood" and turns it into a whole experience: a playlist of songs, ambient noise and a looping video backdrop

Here's the first 4 I made:
— Haight: San Francisco's Summer of Love
— Mussoorie [2:22]: A Ruskin Bond evening in the hills
— Baarish [3:19]: Calcutta in the monsoons
— Mehfil [5:00]: Qawalli night at Nizammudin

Just dictate out the vibe you’re feeling, cast it to the TV, and it can keep going indefinitely..
